## ✨ Feature Description
A clear and concise description of the feature you'd like to see added to FutureVest.

## 🎯 Problem Statement
What problem does this feature solve? What pain point does it address?

## 💡 Proposed Solution
Describe the solution you'd like to see implemented. Include as much detail as possible.

## 🎨 Design Ideas
If you have any design ideas, mockups, or wireframes, please include them here.

## 📱 User Stories
As a [user type], I want [goal] so that [benefit].

### Example User Stories
- As a **student**, I want to see my repayment progress in a visual chart so that I can better understand my financial obligations.
- As an **investor**, I want to receive monthly portfolio summaries so that I can track my investment performance.
- As an **admin**, I want to bulk export user data so that I can generate compliance reports.

## 📈 Impact Assessment

### User Impact
- [ ] High - Affects all users
- [ ] Medium - Affects many users
- [ ] Low - Affects some users
- [ ] Minimal - Affects few users

### Business Impact
- [ ] High - Significant business value
- [ ] Medium - Good business value
- [ ] Low - Some business value
- [ ] Minimal - Limited business value

### Technical Impact
- [ ] High - Major architectural changes
- [ ] Medium - Moderate technical effort
- [ ] Low - Minor technical effort
- [ ] Minimal - Simple implementation
